note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1939: nominations closed 25 April 1939 and, after Gibson withdrew in Kernan, "all other candidates nominated are returned unopposed"; no poll. "The other retiring members, who include Mr. J. H. Walsh, will probably be co-opted to the Council." The Belfast News-Letter (26 April 1939, p. 3) and Portadown News (29 April 1939, p. 2) say the nine divisions other than Kernan had no nominations other than retiring members. Returned unopposed. Archibald Dunlap Gibson, J.P., was also nominated but withdrew his nomination on Wednesday 26 April 1939 (Portadown Times, 28 April 1939, p. 3; Portadown News, 29 April 1939, p. 2).
